messages:
maria-cs: FYI billing-bot just flagged HelioData — hosted spend is ~42% over their committed monthly budget this week. Can we triage quickly?
billing-bot: 🚨 ALERT: HelioData (acct: HLD-992) - hosted API spend 42% > commit. Largest delta: embeddings (↑6.1M tokens/day). Dashboard: https://console.redwood/usage/HLD-992
jake-ops: Do we see any infra pressure or error spikes from that extra traffic?
oliver-eng: Latency uptick in eu-west-1 during 02:00-03:30 UTC window, 95p moved from 210ms -> 380ms. Also saw a burst of 429s from batching queue at 02:18 UTC.
lina-qa: Quick glance at logs: a scheduled nightly job started at 02:00 that loops over >10k docs and calls /embeddings with batch_size=1. Probably the main culprit.
maria-cs: Sophie on the account mentioned a data refresh was enabled last week but said it should be incremental. We should confirm whether they changed batch size or switched to a full reindex.
jake-ops: If it's batch_size=1 we should mitigate by routing those jobs to a lower-cost model or pausing until we coordinate. I can set a temporary cap on hosted for that API key — want me to?
oliver-eng: Yes please. Also proposing immediate routing rule: if request is embeddings and tokens > 5000 then route to quantized-embed-1 (cheaper) and add rate limit 50rps. I can push a canary policy now.
maria-cs: Please do both. Also creating a ticket to customer: ask them to confirm job config and whether they rolled out a new pipeline. I'll schedule a 15m sync.
lina-qa: Patch snippet that would reduce pressure (suggest to customer):
```
# suggest batching change
for chunk in chunks(documents, batch_size=128):
  client.embeddings.create(model="embed-xxl", input=chunk)
```
maria-cs: Good. Note for CS: current burn rate projection if unchanged = 2.3x commit for the month. Need to flag renewal risk if they don't revert.
jake-ops: Action items: 1) I'll apply soft cap on the API key and notify the account (done within 10m). 2) Post routing rule to divert heavy embedding jobs to quantized-embed-1 (canary first).
oliver-eng: I'll deploy the routing policy and add a fallback model with lower QPS cost. Will monitor 5m.
maria-cs: I'll send the customer the suggested batching snippet and request a config checklist. Also ask for ETA to revert or move to scheduled windows.
lina-qa: QA note: after routing rule the 429s should drop; if not we should increase instance pool temporarily.
jake-ops: Cap applied (soft cap 60% of current commit), customer notified via email.
billing-bot: NOTE: provisional billing hold applied to prevent >80% overage. Contact support@redwood if customer disputes.
maria-cs: Great. We'll update during tomorrow's weekly account health with final numbers. If anyone sees additional anomalies, ping here. :thumbsup:
oliver-eng: Monitoring now — will post updated metrics in 10m.
thread_text_preview: billing-bot alert -> embeddings spike; routing, cap, and CS outreach planned
